name: Penn Cruc
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.

attributes.attribute: the Welsh harvest god, liked to Crom Cruach

text: Penn Cruc is a Welsh god or hero. He is the Welsh match for the Irish harvest god Crom Cruach. The two names carry a like ring. Penn Cruc was worshipped at ancient mounds and at standing stones. The record on him is thin, yet it ties his cult to the same harvest ground as the Irish figure.

okr.objective: Present Penn Cruc as the Welsh harvest god.
key_results: Name Penn Cruc as a Welsh god or hero
Mark him as the Welsh match for Crom Cruach
Note his worship at mounds and stones
